description: Use when an agent needs a 24/7 price for a stock, index, commodity or currency outside market hours. Returns Hyperliquid HIP-3 perp markets: oracle and mark price, premium, hourly and 8h funding, open interest, 24h change and the dex. With symbol (TSLA, GOLD, EUR or xyz:TSLA): every live market for it. Without: the whole list. Prices are each market's own HIP-3 oracle and mark. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

symbol.description: a HIP-3 ticker such as TSLA, GOLD, EUR, or a dex-qualified market such as xyz:TSLA
